ننكتب (form VII)
# نَنْكَتِبُ (nankatibu) /nan.ka.ti.bu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْكَتَبَ (inkataba)
# نَنْكَتِبَ (nankatiba) /nan.ka.ti.ba/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْكَتَبَ (inkataba)
# نَنْكَتِبْ (nankatib) /nan.ka.tib/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْكَتَبَ (inkataba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
